subject: Re: Dedicated sizing request & allocation decision for AtlasAI / StellarNet
thread_messages:
From: Maya Lutz <maya@atlasai.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity request for Q4 pilot

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week — AtlasAI is ready to pilot Redwood Dedicated for our real-time agent product. We have a short RFP/sizing ask so we can finalize procurement and timeline: estimated sustained peak of 80k tokens/sec across 8 concurrent model shards, average sequence len 512, expected rollout start 2027-10-01 for a 3-month pilot.

Can you confirm whether Dedicated pool reservation can guarantee the committed throughput and what the minimum tranche size is? I attached our initial sizing sheet. Also flagged: StellarNet indicated they will need a surge window in mid-October per their contract — curious if that impacts our ability to reserve.

Requested: written confirmation of sizing, timeline, and any potential conflicts.

Thanks,
Maya Lutz
Head of Platform Partnerships
AtlasAI

Attachment: atlas-sizing-sheet.xlsx (xlsx, 78KB)
From: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Lutz <maya@atlasai.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity request for Q4 pilot

Karthik / Grace — forwarding Atlas's request. TL;DR: 80k tokens/sec sustained, 8 shards, pilot begins 2027-10-01. Atlas asked about tranche minimums and whether StellarNet's mid-Oct surge blocks reservation.

Specific asks:
- Can we commit to Atlas's requested throughput with a Dedicated tranche of the size they expect?
- If not, what ordered fallback can we offer (smaller reserved tranche + scheduled burst windows)?
- Is there a material conflict with StellarNet that forces a choice? (They have higher ARR but a signed surge clause.)

Please treat as urgent — Atlas wants the confirmation for their procurement, and procurement timelines are tight. Happy to hop on a 30-min sync if needed.

-Avery
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Maya Lutz <maya@atlasai.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity request for Q4 pilot

Avery — quick readout from infra sizing and capacity planning: we can technically support Atlas's requested sustained throughput, but it requires committing ~12 x A100-equivalent GPU tranches with inferred headroom for autoscale (we size for 25% buffer). That commitment is meaningful against our Q4 pool.

Conflict note: StellarNet (deal signed, reserve clause) has a negotiated mid-Oct burst window that maps to an overlapping calendar slice and would consume approximately 6 x A100-equivalent tranches during their surge. StellarNet's contract includes a higher committed ARR and a contractual burst priority clause.

Options (short):
1) Offer Atlas a staggered tranche: start with 6 tranches reserved + scheduled burst windows (off-peak) to cover peak traffic. Full 12-tranche reservation would be possible only if we can shift StellarNet's burst or if StellarNet agrees to an explicit carve-out.
2) Promote Atlas to a prioritized allocation for an up-sell (premium SLA / accelerated commit) — requires revenue approval from Sales Ops and an executive exception because it would temporarily reduce available capacity for StellarNet's burst.
3) Hybrid approach: commit to baseline reserved capacity for both, implement KV-prefix caching and inference quantization recommendations to reduce sustained GPU footprint for Atlas (engineering work needed, 2-3 weeks).

I recommend option 1 + pursue option 3 in parallel. If Sales wants exception for option 2, we need sign-off from Lauren (Ops lead for Dedicated SLAs) + a draft amendment to StellarNet (to defer/limit their burst or offer credits).

Attachment: preliminary-allocation-estimate.csv (csv, 12KB)

-Karthik
Director, Capacity Planning
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Lutz <maya@atlasai.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@stellarnet.io>, procurement@stellarnet.io
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity request for Q4 pilot

Looping in formal priorities: As Capacity Ops lead I need facts to make an allocation decision. Summary of constraints: StellarNet = signed contract with burst clause; Atlas = active opportunity with pilot commitment and procurement timeline.

To Sales (Avery): please provide Atlas's signed pilot LOI or PO by EOD Wed 2027-08-11 if you want us to treat this as a near-term reservation candidate. Without that, we must uphold contractual priorities. If Atlas can commit to the premium SLA upsell (prepay + 6-month minimum), we can consider an exception and reassign capacity for the Oct window.

To Infra (Karthik): prepare two artifacts for my review by EOD Wed 2027-08-11:
- Allocation runbook with exact tranches used per scenario (baseline/staggered/full) and the rollback plan if contention hits SLA thresholds.
- Customer-facing note that explains the technical tradeoffs and mitigations for Atlas (what functionality or latency expectations change under the staggered plan).

I will escalate to Legal/Product for any contract amendment language required for StellarNet. We will not preempt a signed contractual burst without exec-level approval and compensatory terms.

-Lauren
VP, Dedicated Operations
From: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
To: Maya Lutz <maya@atlasai.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@stellarnet.io>, procurement@stellarnet.io
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: temporary allocation path for Atlas pilot (next steps)

Hi Maya / Carlos — quick update and next steps after internal review. Thank you both for your patience.

Decision summary:
- We will provision an initial reserved tranche for Atlas equal to 6 x A100-equivalent GPU capacity, effective 2027-10-01. This is a committed tranche that supports the pilot baseline and is priced per our Dedicated tranche rates.
- We will schedule two guaranteed burst windows (Oct 10–12 and Oct 24–25) where Atlas can use additional capacity up to the requested peak, subject to advance notice and a burst fee. Those windows are coordinated to avoid overlap with StellarNet's confirmed surge (StellarNet retains priority for their signed burst).
- Engineering (Grace & Karthik) will run a 2-week optimization sprint to apply prefix caching and quantization recommendations to Atlas's inference pipeline; expected reduction 15–25% in sustained GPU footprint. Completion target: 2027-09-24.

Actions for Atlas:
1) Please return a signed pilot LOI or PO referencing DEAL-2027-ATLAS-0042 by EOD 2027-08-13 to lock the initial 6-tranche reservation.
2) Confirm preferred burst fee acceptance for the two windows (we will send an invoice schedule after LOI receipt).
3) Grant engineering access to a short test dataset and the model container by 2027-08-17 to start the optimization sprint.

Actions for StellarNet (Carlos):
- We do not need a change to StellarNet's contract today; we will notify you of the scheduled Atlas burst windows and confirm there is no overlap with your surge. If StellarNet prefers tighter isolation, we can discuss an optional isolated pool at a premium.

I'll follow up with the official LOI template and the allocation runbook once Karthik delivers the artifacts Lauren requested. If either customer needs to escalate, please direct to me and Lauren.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: allocation-runbook.md (md, 4KB), LOI-template.pdf (pdf, 24KB)
